title: Blue Mountain Beach "Coastal Haven" 197 Satinwood Drive
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "Coastal Haven" 197 Satinwood Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $35 per day.- Low-Speed Vehicle- Event-friendly- 5 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Sun and fun await at Coastal Haven, a Blue Mountain Beach Main Home and Carriage House accommodating up to 18 guests. This event-friendly property boasts 5 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, a heated pool, and an outdoor kitchen. Known for its easygoing community and the blue lupine flowers that give the area its name, Blue Mountain Beach is a must-visit Emerald Coast location. Discover unique artwork and funky boutiques alongside quintessential coastal activities, including paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing!Elegant archways, hardwood flooring, and modern accents curate an intimate setting inside the 2-story Main House. Recline on the leather chaise sofa and 2 armchairs for a post-beach evening watching movies on the Smart TV and soundbar. The well-appointed kitchen, featuring stone countertops, LG appliances, and a 4-stool breakfast, is seamlessly connected for easy meal prep. An elegant dining table for 8 waits for lively group dinners in the nearby windowed alcove. The true gem of the home is the backyard. Enjoy lounging on the organically shaped private pool’s sundeck or sipping fresh lemonade beneath the umbrella of the 4-person table while the youngsters play! Host a barbecue at the outdoor kitchen with a built-in gas grill with a sink under the pergola—the alfresco dining table seats 10. When the night ends, tuck the kids in the guest bedroom’s 2 twin beds and head upstairs for additional sleeping accommodations.On the sunny second level, the primary bedroom has a king bed and twin-over-twin bunk, while the guest bedroom has a queen bed. Both include Smart TVs and private balconies.The Carriage House is the ultimate spot for viewing parties or hanging with friends—equipped with an 85” Smart TV, large leather couch, 4 armchairs, an expansive table for 17, and a spacious kitchen with high-end appliances. The guest bedroom has a king bed, and the bunk room has 2 full-over-full beds, making this property perfect for multiple families or large groups.Let Coastal Haven set the stage for a delightful Blue Mountain Beach getaway. Exploring is easy with on-site parking for 3-4 vehicles, a 6-seater golf cart, and 5 complimentary adult bikes. The closest beach access is Gulfview Heights—a 2-minute drive or 10-minute walk. Book this home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 18):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboCARRIAGE HOUSESECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: 2 Full-over-Full Bunk Beds with Shower/Tub Combo*Fireplace is not for guest use.*Parties, weddings, or events held at the property must be pre-approved in writing by Callista. Fees apply. Contact us for additional details.
